The filing is NOT split or adjudicated — it is one report with one summary page and one pair of schedules, and both labels are recorded as printed. THE TWO SIDES ARE EQUAL TO THE CENT (4,177.47 each) and that is the filer's own arithmetic: he contributed exactly the 473.51 needed to spend out to a zero closing balance, the same pattern Rodney Campbell used on his 2010 Recorder filing in this chunk (2,003.75 each), with the difference that Campbell labelled his own money '(personal loan)' and Smith labelled his nothing at all.
